metadata.method_name: RQ1 held-out indicator portability (DEV freeze -> sealed held-out scoring)
metadata.description: One example per frame concept: input = the ~53 candidate indicators + B5 over t0..t0+2; output = the 8 outcomes; predict_* = B5-only, B5 + best single indicator (frozen DEV #1), ElasticNet/L1-logistic on all indicators, and EBM, per outcome.
metadata.demo_subset: 100 cohort concepts (t0 2010-14) with all 4 continuous outcomes observed: 50 COH_DEVHOME (home CS/Eng/BGM/Med) + 50 COH_OTHER (home PHYS/LIFEENV/SOC/MATHDEC), stratified by home group, seed 20260928
